description: Compact JWS (ES256, did:key) conformance vectors for packages/shared/src/jws.ts. testKey.privateKeyHex is TEST-ONLY — never used for anything but generating these fixtures. valid[] entries must verifyCompact(jws, testKey.did) -> ok(payload). invalid[] entries must verifyCompact(jws, did) -> err(...) for the stated reason. Consumed by packages/shared/test/jws.test.ts; intended to be replayed by the web viewer against its own JWS implementation (03-spec §3).

testKey.note: TEST-ONLY private key scalar. Never used in production.

invalid.name: bad-signature
invalid.reason: signature byte corrupted after signing (originally signed { action: 'exchange' })

invalid.name: tampered-payload
invalid.reason: payload segment replaced with { amount: 999999 } after signing { amount: 1 }; signature no longer matches

invalid.name: kid-did-mismatch
invalid.reason: JWS is validly signed by testKey but its kid says testKey.did; verifying it against an unrelated did (the identityDeep parity fixture DID) must fail the kid/did check
